description: NaLiTi₃O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.80 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.78 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with ten TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-65°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.05 Å. There are four inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six TiO₆ octahedra. There are five shorter (1.96 Å) and one longer (1.97 Å) Ti-O bond length. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three TiO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-27°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.11 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three TiO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-27°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.12 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six TiO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and four longer (1.97 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Li and three Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, and two Ti atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Li and three Ti atoms to form distorted corner-sharing OLiTi₃ tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ti atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li and two Ti atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ti atoms.
